the prevalence of pulmonary tuberculosis is significantly higher (P<0.045) among low income group as compare to high income group.

the prevalence of pulmonary tuberculosis is significantly higher in low income group than high income group and poor socio-economic status with poor knowledge of TB, risk of infection & dissemination, inadequate & delayed health care and poor nutrition are the main risk factors for pulmonary tuberculosis in Western U.P.

poor socio-economic status with inadequate and delayed health care is associated with poor awareness of tuberculosis, poor knowledge of risk factors, poor nutrition, poor health seeking behavior and high prevalence of pulmonary tuberculosis.
